sentences.en: Six high-tech companies set up branch offices in that prefecture.
sentences.zh: 有六家高科技公司在那个自治省设立了分公司。

sentences.en: Algeria needs to solve its environmental problems with high-tech solutions.
sentences.zh: 阿尔及利亚需要用高科技手段来解决其环境问题。

sentences.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.
sentences.zh: 日本在世界高科技产业中处于领先地位。
